name: quiz_cloze
description: Make cloze (gap-fill) questions from a text: blank the most frequent or longest content words, a given list of words or phrases, or every n-th word, reproducibly with an optional seed; returns the gapped text with numbered blanks, the answer key and the same text in Anki cloze syntax ({{c1::...}}), one card per gap or all on one card. English or Spanish stopwords.

terms.description: terms: words or phrases to blank

seed.description: Shuffles ties (auto) and picks the offset (nth) reproducibly

input.text: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell. The cell needs energy, and the mitochondria make it.

output.cloze_text: The _____ (1) is the powerhouse of the _____ (2). The cell needs energy, and the mitochondria make it.
output.anki: The {{c1::mitochondria}} is the powerhouse of the {{c2::cell}}. The cell needs energy, and the mitochondria make it.

catalog.source: original; fixed-ratio cloze procedure after Taylor (1953); Anki cloze deletion syntax from the Anki Manual (Editing > Cloze Deletion)
